scope: local-only asset storage path admission hardening

change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs uses one canonical POSIX-relative path predicate for database asset storage keys and manifest entries
change.boundary: backup creation and restore reject absolute, backslash, empty, dot-segment and control-character asset paths before atomic promotion
change.negativeFixture: a synthetic SQLite asset record and matching local file whose storage key contains an embedded newline

limitations: Canonical storage paths prevent path-transport ambiguity but do not authenticate backup contents.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
